name: seawall_charges_every_four
description: The Seawall charges by damage taken (design 1.4): every 4 lives seat 2's Holdfast loses add a charge, at most 2. Its lives set down in steps (a logged scenario setter, which counts as lives lost as a leak does): 3 lost, none yet; the 4th, one; 7, still one; 8, two; 12, still two (the cap, the extra four go nowhere); a burst spends one, and 4 more lost give it back. Gaining lives charges nothing, and seat 1, whose team lost none, holds none.

steps.msg: a charge for every 4 lives lost, at most 2
a burst in the wave spent one
4 more lost gave it back; seat 1 lost none and holds none
